text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Finished shopping for daily essentials... Returning to the academy
and preparing to start traini—

text_block_list.name: Sporting Goods Store Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Boost your efficiency with the latest training gear!
Our sporting goods store is having its grand reopening~♪

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"27 minutes and 4 seconds remaining until training commences.
Determined that there is sufficient time to verify efficiency."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa... Abdominal stimulation via ab machine...
+5% above normal... detected...

text_block_list.name: Sporting Goods Store Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for the test ride~!
Our next product achieves a 10% increase...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"...10 seconds until training commences.
Calculating optimal solution for next action."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: —Calculation complete. Continuing to consider new products will likely increase our win rate in future races.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Result: Father and Master are overjoyed.
...Status: 'Cheered up' confirmed.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
To achieve the best results,
I request trial use and data disclosure for all products...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, Mihono Bourbon tried out every single product in the store... and ended up slacking off on training.
